site.title: Juniper & Oak
site.description: Hand-poured soy candles, small batches, shipped from our studio.
site.markdown:
# Juniper & Oak

Hand-poured soy candles in small batches. New scents each season, and from this autumn a monthly box.

## The subscription box

One new candle a month, chosen by the studio. Pause or skip any time.

## Stockists

Find us in about 40 shops. See the map.

## Newsletter

Join the list for drops and studio news. [Sign up form, posts to forms.mailhaven.example]

Email by Mailhaven. Shop by our studio. Candles by hand.

evidence: The newsletter signup on the home page posts to a Mailhaven form.

data.headline: Pollen next to Mailhaven, for Juniper & Oak
data.intro: Your site names Mailhaven: the newsletter signup posts to a Mailhaven form and the footer credits it. Here is how Pollen lines up with it on the seven things a small email team touches. Mailhaven is the better fit on three rows, SMS among them, Pollen on three, and one is a wash.
data.them_fit: Stay with Mailhaven if SMS is on your list for this year, or if you run many variants inside a flow and lean on its builder. It is also already set up, which counts for something.
data.us_fit: Pollen is the better fit if the subscription box you launched in September needs its own flows and segments, and if you want a dedicated sending domain with placement checks before each drop.
